metas.name: The Rivals of Amziah King
metas.description: A beekeeper who anchors his small community reunites with his former foster daughter while threats close in on his honey business. It's a slow-burn rural crime thriller with menace under a folksy surface.

metas.name: The Whisper Man
metas.description: A grieving father and his son move to a town still haunted by a serial killer who may have had an accomplice. A dark crime thriller built on a slowly closing trap.

metas.name: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
metas.description: A devout hitman races across Houston to protect his children after his wife dies. A tense crime drama about a violent man whose beliefs are coming apart.

metas.name: Other Mommy
metas.description: A girl in a home torn by her parents' marriage meets a sinister presence from her closet that calls itself Other Mommy. Domestic horror where the family drama feeds the threat.

metas.name: La Grazia
metas.description: Sorrentino's drama about a widowed Italian president deciding on euthanasia and pardons for killers while brooding over his late wife's infidelity. Dry and morally knotty.

metas.name: Father Mother Sister Brother
metas.description: Jarmusch's deadpan triptych of estranged adult children visiting their cool, distant parents. Quiet, dry and painfully awkward.

metas.name: V/H/S/Mixtape
metas.description: The latest found-footage anthology, built this time around music and sound. A string of short, nasty scares.

metas.name: The Death of Robin Hood
metas.description: A bleak reinvention with an aging Robin Hood haunted by a life of murder and offered a strange chance at salvation. Grim and violent.

metas.name: Zeta
metas.description: A Spanish spy hunts a former agent from an old undercover mission while a Colombian operative chases the same man. A cold-blooded espionage thriller about buried secrets.

metas.name: Disclosure Day
metas.description: Spielberg's sci-fi mystery about what happens when proof arrives that we aren't alone. Builds on paranoia rather than spectacle.
